Bulldog veterinary care in Los Angeles

We are a veterinary practice in Los Angeles focused on brachycephalic breeds: English bulldogs, French bulldogs and pugs. Our work concentrates on airway surgery, eye surgery and endoscopy for dogs whose anatomy makes ordinary anaesthesia risky. Every consultation starts with an airway assessment because breathing effort is the signal that changes the whole surgical plan for a bulldog.

Owners come to us after months of snoring, exercise intolerance and regurgitation. The first thing we explain is that these are not personality traits of the breed, they are symptoms of a narrowed airway that surgery can usually correct. Read more about BOAS surgery for bulldogs or about cherry eye surgery.

We also run gastrointestinal endoscopy, dental work with airway-aware anaesthesia, and orthopaedic procedures. Recovery protocols for brachycephalic dogs differ from other breeds and we walk every owner through the first seventy-two hours in detail, because that window is where most complications appear.
